clean_body: Andy lost his daughter to gun violence, now he’s working for a better future for all our families. | | | | | | | | | | | | | | | Peter, Andy Parker's ready to fight for all of us. Will you join him to create an unstoppable movement to fight gun violence? As we have told you before, Andy Parker is an inspiration who has turned a tragedy into a life of activism to make us all safer. You may remember the tragedy that befell his daughter, Alison Parker, in 2015. A TV reporter in Roanoke, VA, Alison was conducting a live interview when a crazed killer shot and murdered. Another senseless and preventable slaughter in America, but because of its sensational nature, it went viral. Today Andy was invited along with others in the gun-violence-prevention movement to the White House to sign the first gun-safety legislation in nearly 30 years. It is far from perfect, but it closes the "dating" loophole, preventing violent stalkers from getting guns and finally gives us a law to fight gun trafficking nationally. But he knows, like we do, that it isn't enough. So he is kicking off Andy's Fight, a SuperPAC that will be different from other gun-violence prevention groups in some VERY IMPORTANT WAYS: | | | | | | 1) Andy Isn't Playing Nice: He supports any legislation that saves lives, like that being signed today, but will not embark on an endless search for bipartisanship like so many gun groups. He cares about OUR LIVES. Andy won't tepidly call for reforms that are desperately needed--like a ban on assault rifles and high-capacity magazines that are killing our kids in school and our families everywhere from parades to grocery stores. He will scream it from the rooftops, tv stations, digital platforms, street protests, and, hell, maybe even outside of a Morton's while a coddled Kavanaugh munches down a steak flanked by private security. 2) Andy Will Take On Disinformation: Violent imagery, conspiracies and lies that are the fuel that inspire these killers MUST BE STOPPED. There are plenty of ways we can prevent much of it while still respecting the 1st Amendment. So as, thankfully, we are today getting the first gun-safety legislation, Andy knows this isn't nearly enough . He will fight for reforms we must have, take on the politicians and corporate toadies who profiteer from gun violence and violent imagery online. They shall be given no quarter. Thank you for doing all you can to make horrific gun violence a thing of the past in the near future. In just a few short minutes, Michigan State Senator Mallory McMorrow absolutely DEMOLISHES the entire bigoted agenda of today’s Republican Party. = I’m sick and tired of Democrats running away from the culture wars. We need to elect people who aren’t afraid to stand up, look the Republicans in the eye, and tell them we’re not buying their $#*% ANYMORE! = We are trying to keep kids alive. Study upon study shows that the LGBTQ+ community — specifically trans folks — are at a much higher risk of suicide due to anti-queer attacks. Anti-trans legislation and Florida’s new “Don’t Say Gay” law hurt our kids. = Rather, we’re trying to acknowledge how white supremacy and racism have and continue to impact our nation. If we hope to make headway on racial justice in this country, we must have leaders unafraid to address its root causes and propose real solutions. = We want to make sure schools are fully funded, teachers are paid what they deserve, and that books aren’t banned! = We’re the party of family values. We’re the party that cares about kids. We’re the party that gives a damn about righting historical wrongs. But my opponents have dove headfirst into the culture wars. They've accused Disney of being “perverted by a woke mob of liberal extremists” who are using our kids as “guinea pigs” and support banning textbooks in our schools. We can’t empower more far-right folks who will use “culture war” issues as cheap tactics to win elections. So, I’m asking for your support. = | | | = | | = | | = | | = | | = | | = Thank you! subject: What is a “Gender Support Plan”?
body:
We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help t
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2znq8cq3fqf5vf29or2916ja1ce82oj2mue8mpk88_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jk5p7atdge5p78d5jmeqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicboeadr4ehpm7cj4sth7ctlgeaqm0pjiedgrastlc2qj9pjlear7ctjkm4qr8cjgcv970sj2cpob4pjgsipm6o3i6tj33c5lm9jr5cb662ob4pj0s2qm6o70mkoj3d9hmlp238h1e8he4933cljmaor1c9i68oh5u)
| | | Dear Fellow Conservative, We have the key to stop our children from being corrupted by the radical Left in our schools -- and I need your immediate help to win... [**That’s why I’m asking you to make an emergency donation of $35 or more today.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zh3oailkivi24a754a95gks1ikfjpcrbjj859djg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7clhm2oj4chh2bs) We recently filed suit against a school AND the activists pretending to be teachers to make them pay for what they’re doing to our young and vulnerable children. Because the ONLY way we’re going to stop them -- is to make these extremists pay for their crimes... And that’s exactly what our landmark lawsuit does! Let me quickly give you the details in case you missed us while we were on **Laura Ingraham** ’s great **Fox News **show talking about our case: Jessica Konen, the mother of an innocent 12-year-old girl, was called into her daughter’s school and told that her daughter was now a “boy”. She found out that her young daughter had been groomed into believing she was “transgender” and “bisexual”... Her impressionable daughter didn’t even know these words until they were forced on her by these radicals. The school then pushed Jessica’s innocent daughter to create a whole new identity -- complete with a new boy’s name, new pronouns and had her use a different bathroom... They also created a “Gender Support Plan” and ordered the faculty to use her new name and pronouns -- all without her mother’s knowledge! **And Jessica had no idea because her young daughter was told NOT to tell her mother since she couldn’t be “trusted”****.**
* These people are not real teachers.
* They’re not concerned with teaching our children to read...
* They’re not concerned with teaching our children math and arithmetic...
* They’re not concerned with teaching history...

They want to indoctrinate an entire generation of children to reject their parent’s values and embrace their radical Left-Wing propaganda -- and we have to stop them. [**That’s why I’m asking you to rush in your donation of $35 or more to help us stop these child groomers now.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmqjpj0fotofl377uqceagkj8hrj3gaoi63hmutg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7clhm2oj4chh2bs) After all this, Jessica did what any good mother would do and questioned the principal about what was happening to her young daughter at school... ... And what happened next? Child Protective Services was called to her house and “interviewed” her children! This grooming is happening behind closed doors in classrooms across the country... And it’s happening in secret so parents, grandparents andthe community don’t know what’s going on. Jessica’s innocent daughter is just one of the countless victims -- and if we don’t act, there will be more and more every day... Since we announced our lawsuit **The Ingraham Angle** , tons of concerned parents, grandparents and teachers have reached out to us. It’s horrible and sickening that this is happening, but we have to stop it... And our lawsuit is the key. Political pressure and new laws will not work -- we must drag these radical activists and schools into court and make them pay. That’s why our lawsuit names the individual “teachers” -- we must hold **them** accountable... Only when these extremists are scared of being dragged into court and are forced to pay will they stop. Make no mistake -- if we win this landmark case every single one of these so-called teachers will take notice. They will think of the consequences before pushing their radical agenda on our vulnerable children... [**So please, join me today with a donation of $35 or more to fund our lawsuit to protect our kids from out of control leftist teachers.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z49s94vprr7uo3mvph3lmtjda5kbknpfqq575nn8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7clhm2oj4chh2bs) But to stop them, we need to win this case... And if you can give more today – $50, $100, $250 or more – I will use it to protect our children and our constitutional rights from these radical Left extremists. But, whatever amount you can send, I ask that you rush it in right away. And please know that here at the Center for American Liberty we don’t just file lawsuits – we **WIN** them!! We recently won three major victories for religious liberty before the U.S. Supreme Court and we’re fighting Big Tech and the politicians who are conspiring to silence and destroy conservatives... But this case to stop these extremists from corrupting and damaging our innocent children is too important to lose. And the only way to stop them is to make them know we’re going to make them pay for their actions... [**So please, join the fight today****with your emergency tax-deductible donation of $20, $35, $50, $100 or more today.**](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zubl3o9ddau4l7te7338hmrj9l4vfg6phnehbiso_rp22sh2s8i66pb7clhm2oj4chh2bs) We’re ready to go to the mat to win this case, but we can’t do it without you. Thank you in advance for your support. Sincerely,

Harmeet K. Dhillon

Hey Peter Willis,
Last week, President Biden signed an executive order to protect women's reproductive rights in the aftermath of the Supreme Court's drastic decision to overturn _Roe v. Wade._ The order will expand access to emergency contraception and IUDs, increase outreach and public education on abortion, protect patient privacy, and more.
While this is a significant step forward in protecting reproductive rights nationally, _it is not enough._ We STILL need to expand the court and take additional bold steps to ensure reproductive equality for everyone.
As Melanie said, “Being “Pro-choice” must mean more than passive support.”
We must ensure our reproductive rights are never threatened; we believe in never accepting half-measures and taking action even when it's not politically convenient.
**We’re not done fighting for reproductive justice.** That’s why we need _your signature_ on our five demands that we will deliver to President Biden, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, and Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi.

Melanie’s plan won’t just ensure reproductive rights are protected for the next four years — she’ll make sure they are protected for generations to come.
By passing the Women's Health Protection Act, Congress could codify _Roe v. Wade_ into law. The WHPA would prohibit states from creating unnecessary barriers for people to access reproductive care. But we need Democrats to grow a spine and eliminate the filibuster or create a carve-out so we can pass this bill with a simple majority in the Senate.
Melaine’s plan would also make the Supreme Court a people’s court. Passing the Judiciary Act would expand the Supreme Court by four seats, bringing the total back up to 13 seats for the 13 circuits. Adding more Supreme Court justices would ensure that it never reflects only one party’s political agenda, ensuring the people's will.
She’s also calling on President Biden to finally repeal the Hyde Amendment and for Congress to ratify the Equal Rights Amendment.

While this is a significant step forward in protecting reproductive rights nationally, it is not enough. We STILL need to expand the court and take additional bold steps to ensure reproductive equality for everyone. As Melanie said, “Being “Pro-choice” must mean more than passive support.” We must ensure our reproductive rights are never threatened; we believe in never accepting half-measures and taking action even when it's not politically convenient. We’re not done fighting for reproductive justice. That’s why we need your signature on our five demands that we will deliver to President Biden, Senate Majority Leader Chuck Schumer, and Speaker of the House Nancy Pelosi. Melanie’s plan won’t just ensure reproductive rights are protected for the next four years — she’ll make sure they are protected for generations to come. By passing the Women's Health Protection Act, Congress could codify Roe v. Wade into law. The WHPA would prohibit states from creating unnecessary barriers for people to access reproductive care. But we need Democrats to grow a spine and eliminate the filibuster or create a carve-out so we can pass this bill with a simple majority in the Senate. Melaine’s plan would also make the Supreme Court a people’s court. Passing the Judiciary Act would expand the Supreme Court by four seats, bringing the total back up to 13 seats for the 13 circuits. Adding more Supreme Court justices would ensure that it never reflects only one party’s political agenda, ensuring the people's will. | Early in my career, there was a chance

I almost ended up in California.

Thank God that wasn’t my fate.

You see, I graduated from the University of San Diego Law School back in the early 90s, in the middle of a nasty recession...

And those cushy high-paying corporate law jobs were hard to find.

**So I ended up interning at the California District Attorney General’s office instead...**

And while it didn’t pay like the big firms...

_I’m glad it happened that way. _

_Because turns out, I was DAMN good at practicing the law..._

_And one day, I got a call from an Arizona judge to work as an assistant U.S. attorney... _

_And I never looked back._

**_Here’s the funny thing though:_**

_If it wasn’t for that experience in the California DA office, I might not be in Arizona today..._

And if things had worked out that way...

I wonder:
Would I be in California now, paying the highest taxes in the nation—in exchange for high gas prices, extreme Covid mandates (they still have that), out-of-control homelessness, and skyrocketing crime rates?

Well, let’s just say I’m glad that I live in Arizona.

We live in a free state, with more and more opportunities pouring in for every Arizonan.

**But I fear that it won’t always be that way.**

Because if California Democrats get what they want, they’ll turn Arizona into California as soon as they can.

NO THANK YOU.

Let’s keep Arizona the most liberty-loving state in the union.
[**If you’re in, click here to join my campaign.**](https://brnoforaz.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=f2832e79a2cd8992eddbf352a&id=ee02a8ed20&e=6dcd2506d1)

We need a candidate whose got a _real_ shot to beat Mark Kelly...

And frankly that’s me.

I’ve got the proven freedom-first track record that my opponents don’t have...

I’ve won tight races before, while my opponents haven’t...

And while I legitimately hate asking for money...

The stakes are just too high here.

We cannot let Arizona become California...

clean_body: ‌ | | | | Early in my career, there was a chance I almost ended up in California. Thank God that wasn’t my fate. You see, I graduated from the University of San Diego Law School back in the early 90s, in the middle of a nasty recession... And those cushy high-paying corporate law jobs were hard to find. So I ended up interning at the California District Attorney General’s office instead... And while it didn’t pay like the big firms... I’m glad it happened that way. Because turns out, I was DAMN good at practicing the law... And one day, I got a call from an Arizona judge to work as an assistant U.S. attorney... And I never looked back. Here’s the funny thing though: If it wasn’t for that experience in the California DA office, I might not be in Arizona today... And if things had worked out that way... I wonder: Would I be in California now, paying the highest taxes in the nation—in exchange for high gas prices, extreme Covid mandates (they still have that), out-of-control homelessness, and skyrocketing crime rates? Well, let’s just say I’m glad that I live in Arizona. We live in a free state, with more and more opportunities pouring in for every Arizonan. But I fear that it won’t always be that way. Because if California Democrats get what they want, they’ll turn Arizona into California as soon as they can. NO THANK YOU. Let’s keep Arizona the most liberty-loving state in the union. We need a candidate whose got a real shot to beat Mark Kelly... And frankly that’s me. I’ve got the proven freedom-first track record that my opponents don’t have... I’ve won tight races before, while my opponents haven’t... And while I legitimately hate asking for money... The stakes are just too high here. We cannot let Arizona become California... clean_body: Will you help Team Herschel get our new ad up during tonight’s local news? | Fellow American, If you watched local news in Georgia, you'd know Raphael Warnock has been attacking me non-stop. While some folks don't watch local news anymore, many still watch it religiously. And those who watch local news broadcasts are very likely to vote. As you may know, we launched our first TV ad of the general election. Our ad is running on several stations, but we need to expand our advertising buy to run it more often in more areas. It costs $265 to run one ad during the local evening news on WRDW-TV in Augusta, Georgia. And it's not enough to do it just one night of the week because some might not see it. We need to run it seven nights per week during that time slot. That's $265 x 7 = $1,855. It's critical that we expand our media buy and talk directly to more voters. Our opponent in this race has had the Georgia TV airwaves to himself for months and has spent more than $10 million attacking me since I became the Republican nominee on May 24. WE WILL LOSE if we can't get in front of voters and set the record straight. Your contribution by noon tomorrow will allow us to tell folks watching the local news why I'm running and why I'm asking for their support. Thanks in advance, Herschel Walker | | PAID FOR BY TEAM HERSCHEL, INC. Don't want to receive any more of our emails? We hate to see you go, but .

He’s been so busy traveling throughout western Pennsylvania and meeting with voters that I think he might have forgotten – but I didn’t. Unlike yours truly, Chris doesn’t really like “things” and basically wears the same outfit every day, making him impossible to surprise. But I can’t think of a more perfect birthday gift than rallying some support to help Chris take on the radical right.

**[So, I’ve set a goal to raise $3,800 for Chris’s 38th birthday! This fundraising boost in the middle of the month will not only be a fun surprise for Chris, but it will also give Team Deluzio the momentum we need to finish July even stronger than we finished June.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47694828/355266045/-454070568?refcode=em_fr_2022.07.11_b1_zb_all&amount=15&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiMzJiN2E2Ny01MTAxLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=vpmwSaUuBXgk-zFtiZjuUCioRhJC2JlMDn_bF1WGGMM=)**

He’s focused on getting to Congress to fight for working folks and families like ours across Beaver and Allegheny Counties. body:

Pro-Life Statement

http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWZaDZyh3N

From the
Desk of Dr. Ben Carson:
Hello,
In 1973,
the U.S. Supreme Court decided the case Roe v. Wade. And since
that day, more than 63 million babies have been killed through
abortion in our country.
It was
the most destructive ruling in the history of our nation. And it
led to an anti-life ideology that still infects America to this
day.
From what
I've been told, you are someone who values and respects life in
all its stages, and I'm guessing this makes you sick to your
stomach just like it does to me.
But the
tide is changing, and that's why I asked if I could send you this
email today.

Dr. Ben
Carson, Founder and Chairman of American Cornerstone Institute
The U.S.
Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe gives us a historic
opportunity to rebuild a culture of life. The battle for life has
returned to the states. And we have a lot of work to do. Because
the laws and needs of each state vary, it will take a
supercharged effort to fight for the protection of the unborn.
But the
American Cornerstone Institute is committed to providing
resources to support pro-life efforts in each state. And that's
why we need YOU!
Will you
help rebuild a culture of life in states across America by making
a tax-deductible gift today?
We have
seen that the opposition is more hostile than ever now that the
official decision has come down. We got a glimpse at those who
are anti-life have reacted since the leak was made public.
That's
why we're asking you to give right now to help us fight back to
protect life for the unborn with every tool at our disposal.
So,
please don't wait.
You can
make your tax-deductible gift to protect life in states across
America using this secure link:
https://secure.americancornerstone.org/pro-life-states-confirmation
Thank you
so much for any support you can offer.
Regards,

Dr. Ben
Carson
Founder &
Chairman
American
Cornerstone Institute

Your
donation to ACI helps us to focus on our mission of promoting and
preserving individual and religious liberty, helping our
country's most vulnerable find new hope, and developing methods
to decrease the federal government's role in society and to
improve efficiency to best serve ALL our nation's citizens.

# **Welcome to the team, neighbor. **
---
| Welcome to my newsletter! You’re getting this note because you’ve signed my ballot petition, generously contributed to the campaign, or you're someone who wants to see a world in which working families can thrive. In case we haven’t met, I’m Sianay and I’m running for Congress in my home state of Vermont. I’m so happy to connect with you!

I’m running for a simple reason - we need leaders in Congress who will put working families first, no matter what. I’m a social worker, so I know that when we center and support our most vulnerable, our entire communities thrive. For too long, politics as usual has left folks like us behind, and Vermonters deserve someone who will show up to do the work of healing and strengthening all of our communities.**And that’s exactly who I am. **

body:
Friend -- **In a major win for election integrity, the Wisconsin Supreme Court affirmed that ballot drop boxes and ballot harvesting are ILLEGAL.** The WisGOP has long opposed these practices, as they go against the letter of the law, create opportunities for fraud, and undermine confidence in our elections. We even joined the RNC and NRSC in an [**amicus brief**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0R72aAQRdpUWAFwuxNARiAUGeOTbTLvhsakhPOaGLT5xjF6Ub_k46e1PxTPSGnCS5miClFFJZBJseoM49u8vE1k&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=teigan_ruling&n=1) in this case. We’ve fought tooth-and-nail to make sure that our elections are run in accordance with the law. We’re finally starting to see our hard work pay off, and today’s decision is a major step in ensuring that Democrats will be forced into a fair fight that holds them accountable for their record. **But we know that the Democrats won’t let up, and neither should we.** To make sure that we further prevent practices that undermine election integrity, here’s you can do:
1. **Volunteer to elect a Republican governor this fall.** The Legislature passed a number of election integrity [**bills**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0eH7mQqnwg7TiRkzkxQsBEiy2QEaRvsvV0RjO0WcIwL3&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=teigan_ruling&n=2) this session that were VETOED by Tony Evers. We need to elect a Republican governor who will sign these bills and make election integrity a priority. You can sign up to volunteer on our website [**here**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0eXv_5DaexUSZI9PlfXgIO8&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=teigan_ruling&n=3).
2. [**Join**](https://act.wisgop.org/r?u=sxV_uZjhTYiS0NkYk0dD0a23sM2IsUfkW7JDTb3cKks31us6ZQgMJq21hg5RtYyk&e=d00ac07d22940c0f36f888b7fa3c8df2&utm_source=wisgop&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=teigan_ruling&n=4) your county party to stay apprised of opportunities to secure election integrity in your community. body:
I couldn't be more proud to work alongside Cori in Congress
# [](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/143?refcode=em20220711-3210-header&t=1&akid=3210%2E2526796%2EJMrlci)
Hi, it's Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
I’m writing to you today because in just 3 weeks, Rep. Cori Bush will have to face four, corporate-backed challengers in a competitive primary election.
[Will you chip in $3 right now to help Cori push back against these attacks and overcome the dark money being flooded in this race?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220711.sIf6EV&refcode=em20220711-3210-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=3210%2E2526796%2EJMrlci)
Since meeting Cori in 2017, when we were both first-time House candidates running to take on establishment Democrats to today, Cori has always inspired me. **And I couldn't be more proud to work alongside her in Congress.**
[](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220711.sIf6EV&refcode=em20220711-3210-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=3210%2E2526796%2EJMrlci)
**Cori is _exactly_ the leader we need to represent St. Louis in Congress.** As a nurse, pastor, and single mom of two kids, she has always been involved in her community. After the murder of Michael Brown in 2014 just minutes from where she lived, Cori stepped up to serve her neighbors as a triage nurse. When attacks on abortion rights started escalating, Cori began sharing her own abortion story and has been leading the fight to pass urgent reproductive health protections in our communities.
Together, we introduced the Green New Deal for Cities to federally fund a Green New Deal in every community and stayed outside the Capitol for five days demanding an extended eviction moratorium to keep people housed. Districts like Cori's and mine disproportionately feel the impacts of environmental racism, economic inequity, and police violence — that’s why Cori and I understand what's at stake in our work.
**Keeping Cori with me in Congress is absolutely _critical_ to ensuring the future of our progressive movement.** Together, we will continue holding the line to pass Medicare for All, a Green New Deal, abortion access protections, and the anti-racist policies our communities need.
[Will you chip in $3 today to keep Cori in Congress, reach Team Cori's $50,000 fundraising goal, and power their re-election campaign? Cori needs our help today to build the resources to defend against any GOP attacks.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20220711.sIf6EV&refcode=em20220711-3210-P_FND_ANO_END&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=3210%2E2526796%2EJMrlci)

Fellow American,

I don’t know about you, team, but I’m over it.

Over and over again, my fellow House Democrats and I have passed significant legislation addressing the most pressing issues facing everyday Americans: codifying civil rights, curbing inflation, defending our democracy, and so much more. But almost every time, it doesn’t become the law—because it dies in the Senate. Thanks to the filibuster.

The filibuster is a silver bullet for Mitch McConnell and MAGA Republicans to shoot down any and all bills they don’t like that do not have supermajority support. The filibuster is fundamentally undemocratic, is NOT a part of our constitution, and it is the single greatest obstacle to all the progress we badly need in this country. It must be abolished.

I’m damn sick and tired of Senate Democrats obstructing our party’s entire agenda by refusing to abolish or reform the filibuster. So we need to expand our majority in the Senate with Democrats that will abolish or reform it. Chip in now to help expand the Democratic majority in the Senate so we can stop giving MAGA Republicans a unilateral veto on almost every bill that comes their way. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-15-Email-July2022-FR-july?refcode=E16825-20220709-Filibuster-SL-Filibuster-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=15]

What kind of democracy do we live in where the minority party that represents 40 million fewer Americans than the majority party gets to automatically stop the passage of any bill they want, even when it receives a simple majority of votes? That’s not a healthy democracy, that’s a damn joke.

There are many reasons why the American people’s trust in Congress is so low, and the filibuster is chief among them. The filibuster is why abortion rights and marriage equality are not codified, it is why inflation is out of control, it is why voting rights have not been protected...the list goes on. So we must put an end to it.

Contribute now to help us elect more Democrats who will abolish the filibuster and finally take decisive action that supports working Americans. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ESCA-15-Email-July2022-FR-july?refcode=E16825-20220709-Filibuster-SL-Filibuster-RegTemplate-NA-NA&amount=15]

Thanks for sticking with me.

— Eric

name: Team Franchot
subject: Our major endorsement announcement
body:
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/FAWlogo_Blue%404x.png]
Hi Peter,
In case you missed it, we want to make sure you saw our major endorsement announcement – our campaign has been endorsed by U.S. Senator Ed Markey of Massachusetts!
This is one of the biggest announcements of our campaign, and we need your help to turn this into a major fundraising moment. Will you chip in to help us raise $3,000 by our 11:59 PM deadline tonight? With just 8 days to go until Election Day, anything you can give is greatly appreciated. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/edmarkeyendorsement?refcode=kicker&amount=20.22]
Thank you,
T eam Franchot
Forwarded Message Below:
Major endorsement alert! I am deeply honored to receive the endorsement of my friend, U.S. Senator Ed Markey of Massachusetts. I served as Ed’s staff director for six years during his tenure as a Congressman. Over my time on Capitol Hill, I saw firsthand the critical importance of the work conducted by our elected officials. My years with Ed inspired me to run for elected office, and I’ve been proudly serving the people of Maryland ever since.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/edmarkeyendorsement?refcode=kicker&amount=20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/edmarkeyendorsement?refcode=kicker&amount=20.22]
Ed, your endorsement means everything to me. I can’t thank you enough for your friendship, your mentorship, and your support. For decades, you’ve served as one of Congress’s most dynamic, outspoken leaders on critical issues from energy, to environmental protection, to jobs and infrastructure. Just as you’ve inspired me so many years ago, you continue to inspire the young activists of today who will become the bold leaders of tomorrow. As Maryland’s next Governor, I’ll be your proud partner in the fight to spearhead the transition to a greener American economy.
This is one of the biggest endorsement announcements of our campaign, and we need to make it count! Fresh off the heels of this latest endorsement alert, will you chip in to power our movement to victory? We’re looking to raise an additional $3,000 that will go towards the critical tools we need to reach out to voters, and a groundswell of grassroots donations can easily get us to our goal.
CHIP IN $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/edmarkeyendorsement?refcode=kicker&amount=10]
CHIP IN $20.22 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/edmarkeyendorsement?refcode=kicker&amount=20.22]
CHIP IN $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/edmarkeyendorsement?refcode=kicker&amount=50]
CHIP IN $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/edmarkeyendorsement?refcode=kicker&amount=100]
CHIP IN ANOTHER AMOUNT [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/edmarkeyendorsement?refcode=kicker]
With just days to go before the July 19 primary, your contribution will make a critical impact in this make-or-break period for our campaign. Anything you can give will go a long way.
I am so proud that the overwhelming majority of our donations come from right here within the state of Maryland. We’re building a truly grassroots movement composed of Maryland workers, activists, neighbors, and friends, and together we can secure a stronger future for our state in the years to come. From combating climate change, to creating 100,000 new jobs in industries of the future, to protecting and expanding access to abortion at the state level, we’re going to bring the bold solutions and concrete results that our communities need and deserve.
We are the frontrunners in this crowded race, and with your help, we can pull ahead even further in these final, critical days before the July 19 primary. Together, let’s redefine the promise and possibility of state government in the years to come.
Click here to help us meet our fundraising goal of $3,000 by our 11:59 PM deadline tonight. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/edmarkeyendorsement?refcode=kicker&amount=20.22]
Thank you,
[https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81826/images/Franchot%20Signature.png]
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/edmarkeyendorsement?refcode=kicker&amount=20.22]
By Authority: Franchot Anderson-Walker for Maryland Slate; Thomas C. Brennan, Treasurer.

subject: Let’s get to work

body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP10/1/81515/images/Facebook%20Cover.png]
Dear Peter,
In the last few weeks, Lindsey Graham, Donald Trump Jr, and others have weighed in on our 5th Congressional race. People who don’t know anything about middle Tennessee are heavily invested in flipping a congressional seat in our state, and none of them care about the people who live here. I grew up here, and having served on the regional mayors caucus, I know the issues that Maury, Marshall, Lewis, Wilson, and Williamson Counties are facing, as well as my senate district in Davidson County.
Tennesseans are tired of partisan bickering. We’re concerned about inflation, rising taxes, and rising living costs. We’re worried about facing higher prices and lower wages. Fixing our crumbling infrastructure and schools is more important than what big corporations and people in DC want.
I understand all of these things because I’m from here, and I’m your neighbor. My voting record and experience make it clear that I’m focused on solving problems and getting results for the people who live here. That is what matters to me.
This is a battleground race and is going to be one of the most competitive in the country.
If you’re on board and want to help, please consider making a contribution to our effort today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/campbellacq]
We can save the 5th Congressional District. This race is going to be closer than some people think, but we can win it as long as we have the funds to get our message out to voters across the district. Middle Tennesseans want common sense leadership from a common sense person, and that’s exactly what I delivered as a mayor and senator.
Please stand with me in this fight for the 5th!
Heidi Campbell

clean_body: [] Dear Peter, In the last few weeks, Lindsey Graham, Donald Trump Jr, and others have weighed in on our 5th Congressional race. People who don’t know anything about middle Tennessee are heavily invested in flipping a congressional seat in our state, and none of them care about the people who live here. I grew up here, and having served on the regional mayors caucus, I know the issues that Maury, Marshall, Lewis, Wilson, and Williamson Counties are facing, as well as my senate district in Davidson County. Tennesseans are tired of partisan bickering. We’re concerned about inflation, rising taxes, and rising living costs. We’re worried about facing higher prices and lower wages. Fixing our crumbling infrastructure and schools is more important than what big corporations and people in DC want. I understand all of these things because I’m from here, and I’m your neighbor. My voting record and experience make it clear that I’m focused on solving problems and getting results for the people who live here. That is what matters to me. This is a battleground race and is going to be one of the most competitive in the country. If you’re on board and want to help, please consider making a contribution to our effort today. [] We can save the 5th Congressional District. This race is going to be closer than some people think, but we can win it as long as we have the funds to get our message out to voters across the district. Middle Tennesseans want common sense leadership from a common sense person, and that’s exactly what I delivered as a mayor and senator. Please stand with me in this fight for the 5th! * Championed the largest investment in affordable housing in decades
* Increased the minimum wage
* Passed the most expansive reproductive liberty law in the nation

Peter, it's crazy to me that MAGA extremists are attacking the right for a person to obtain an abortion while also blocking efforts to ensure paid family leave and affordable childcare.
Here in Missouri, where women are facing some of the most extreme abortion laws in the country, families are not guaranteed either paid family leave or universal Pre-K. It's cruel to force anyone to give birth, but it's even worse to not help them after they have.
It's backwards and heartless to offer so few protections for families. But this isn't just a moral issue; it's also an economic issue: **More than a million mothers would rejoin the workforce if childcare were affordable.**
**By investing in access to childcare, we would give families more financial security, give more mothers the opportunity to lead their own careers, and give our economy a $48 billion boost every single year.**
As a nurse, a children's advocate, and a parent, I know that the childcare crisis requires bold leadership and swift action. That’s why I included bringing down the cost of childcare by introducing a sliding scale limit on childcare costs for families in **[my affordability plan.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47697582/355279923/-9916195?refcode=jtk113-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZTM3ZTkyMy01ZDAxLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=J2D2n9bOn-KfBQaDsWZJo3ZrBtjakE7bmt8C2f6i6j8=&emci=2e09a5ca-0cff-ec11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=1e37e923-5d01-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=4450063)**

Team, This November, Colorado is hosting some of the most consequential races in the entire country. And everything from the right to choose, to affordable health care, to the fight against climate change is on the line.

One of the closest elections is likely to be in Colorado’s 7th District, so I’m reaching out today to ask you to**[help Brittany Pettersen defeat her GOP opponent](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/47698017/355281332/1751256495?refcode=email_071122_threereasonsImaskingforyourhelp&amount=18&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NmMxOGMzNy01ZjAxLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=09kY4bA1S7wOdm__ZSXt9Pw4TksSuQUKA4WMnw5cxgE=)** — because this one has major stakes, folks. Here are three reasons Brittany deserves your support: 1) Brittany is a staunch defender of reproductive freedom and, as a state legislator, helped pass Colorado’s law protecting the right to choose. Her opponent opposes reproductive freedom. 2) Brittany doesn’t just talk about how things need to change. She delivers results. body:
Beto just announced a Drive for Texas that will take our campaign to every part of the state.
#
Will you be a part of the next chapter of Beto's campaign?
Today, Beto is announcing a Drive for Texas that will take our grassroots campaign back to every part of the state. Here's the plan:
**49 days. 5,600+ miles. 70+ events. 65+ counties. 75+ communities.**
**[](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220711-1.PR1bvW&refcode=ema20220711-197924&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=197924%2E444211%2ElKyj3O)**
With the polls narrowing and Greg Abbott's favorability hitting historic lows, it's time to do everything we can to bring Beto's positive, unifying message to small towns and big cities across the state — _but we need the financial resources to fund our travel and reach every voter possible._
We've set a goal to raise $300,000 to ensure we have the resources to keep Beto on the road, reserve campaign venues, host events, and reach voters — but we'll need the support of this entire grassroots team to hit this goal in time.
**[Can we count on you to chip in to power our statewide Drive for Texas? Reaching this goal will be critical to meeting thousands of new people, spreading the word about our campaign for ALL Texans, and defeating Abbott.](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220711-1.PR1bvW&refcode=ema20220711-197924&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=197924%2E444211%2ElKyj3O)**
In 2018, Beto came closer to winning statewide than any Democrat in decades by visiting each of the state's 254 counties and connecting with voters in their communities.
**Now, with a record 59% of Texans saying the state is heading in the wrong direction under Abbott, we have the chance to make real progress on the issues that are most important to Texans — but we have to meet this moment.**
There's only one way to win this race — by going everywhere and meeting everyone. But bringing Texans together and holding Greg Abbott accountable will only be possible with your support.
**[Please, will you make your first donation now to fund this statewide travel and fund our campaign to elect Beto?](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=bft-em-20220711-1.PR1bvW&refcode=ema20220711-197924&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=197924%2E444211%2ElKyj3O)**

body:
I’m disgusted by the biased media narrative about Black people being victims of systemic racism in 2022.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zcqs4d200j9mvg06uh9ol8dcsq8rtthd079vnnhg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cljmao34cdh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf8s9k69i70obkmcprdd3i6qr3ccb5csqj0pthc4qmct5ke5gj2ttjecq6cthle1jt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coor5ddk61p7aphkcipm6ptgmlin49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z7uqb14atjpje3om7e521sdq8v23e1r382tajar0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cljmao34cdh2bs)

Friend,

I'm disgusted by the biased media narrative about Black people being victims of systemic racism in 2022. This is after we elected a Black president and despite all the evidence of successful Black individuals in mainstream culture.

So why is there a perpetual narrative of Black victimhood?

**Because it is through fear and manipulation the media and organizations like BLM control Black communities. By keeping Black communities as victims, it allows BLM and others to exploit and keep their power over them. **

I too once believed this narrative. But something deep down told me to rethink everything I've been told. It was my grandfather who broke their narrative in a powerful way.

Now before I tell you the story, I want to introduce you to the BLEXIT Foundation.

I co-founded BLEXIT in 2019 in order to break the victimhood mentality in Black and urban communities. I see our communities being exploited by fear and victimhood in order to get them dependent on the government, which in turn breaks up the family, and ultimately, perpetuates the cycle of poverty.

**If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim you become your own oppressor.**

What does "BLEXIT" mean? BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

[_**Please help me shatter the victimhood mentality by donating $250, $100, $35, or any amount towards the BLEXIT Foundation. Give today by clicking here.**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4i3fi9aom60ac8cp8p8s8l4dkfnl58ucc8n5rt0_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cljmao34cdh2bs)

**Story: How my grandfather taught me to never be a victim.**

My grandfather raised me. I didn't come from a perfect home. My parents split up. And what I enjoyed most about my grandfather were his stories.

He grew up during the Jim Crow era and real racism, not this fake racism CNN finds on the internet or lies about.

But there's one story he told I will NEVER forget.

As a boy, he worked on the family's share crop farm. Each morning he would wake up at 4am to lay out the tobacco to dry. Despite their difficult circumstances, they stayed together as a family and persevered.

**Then one night the KKK showed up. My grandfather woke up to bullets being shot into his home. He and his siblings hid underneath their beds.**

And then a smirk came across my grandfather's face "my father got his shotgun and fired back at them boys!"

The way he said it was with so much pride. And what I can't fathom is how in the face of this real danger, my grandfather was proud of his father for fighting back and not giving up.

Can you imagine if we all had this type of attitude?! Not letting circumstances hold us back. Not being a perpetual victim. Nowadays, people need days off work because a comedian told a joke that they don't like!

It was through my grandfather's example that I learned not to ever be a victim.

He eventually bought the same share crop farm his father worked on and started his own farm. He was financially successful, loved his wife, children, and grandchildren for his entire life.

While not everyone can have an individual like my grandfather in their lives, through BLEXIT we are going into Black and urban communities to empower people.

And it's working... _Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 15,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

[_**Friend, I am personally inviting you to support BLEXIT and spread our message of faith, freedom, and family to Black and urban communities. I am looking to raise $30,000 in the next 48 hours to fund our mission. Please click here to donate $1,000, $250, $100, $35, or $10 >>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5l9nh6ejs6rcavt6r02fq8uab9ud5egk8cn6d38_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cljmao34cdh2bs)

[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zl2umknmu3g2pd37p6ehm832cg34coa0jtsce718_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cljmao34cdh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zjh758r15fb19e10lkut5op7fdaa493sf4jbrfgg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cljmao34cdh2bs)

**Here 's how BLEXIT is making a difference:**

BLEXIT enters neighborhoods no one is bothering to help - Detroit, Baltimore, Houston, New Orleans, and many other cities. We are a "do tank", not a think tank. We're providing leadership, education, training, events, and activism to break the grip of victimhood mentality.

I want to see Black communities that are patriotic, entrepreneurial, and spiritual. This is NOT what the mainstream media and BLM want to see.

Here are the BLEXIT Foundation's values, what we're doing to reach Black communities, and what we're fighting for:

* **School Choice:** Often, the people allegedly "fighting for minorities" are doing everything in their power to keep Black and Hispanic students locked into awful schools.

The ugly truth is that these schools are simply brainwashing centers attacking the nuclear family, creating victims, and teaching their twisted values. BLEXIT is fighting for School Choice to empower young Black and Hispanic students to learn real skills, have more opportunities, and escape poverty. [_**You can support BLEXIT 's efforts to fight for School Choice here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztj2j86mbsqhkfmdjlg6fqso8abicq85mmnn0q50_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cljmao34cdh2bs)

* **Criminal Justice Reform:** The mainstream media wants urban communities to hate our law enforcement officers. This ugly message is setting Black Americans back. The BLEXIT Foundation supports our men and women who serve as police officers and defend our communities.

Yes, we do need criminal justice reform. But we believe cooperating with our police officers and connecting as a community is critical to creating justice. BLEXIT Foundation is starting conversations with police officers and urban communities. The media wants you to believe cops are evil! This is wrong. But people never hear this message.

[_**Help the BLEXIT Foundation change the narrative by making a donation here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zuqmb3m5i5t0md1j2l7v14jfupqvkoll6rn6phgg_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cljmao34cdh2bs)

* **Entrepreneurship:** I am passionate about empowering Black and Hispanic Americans. Free markets, responsibility, and advancing the careers of urban communities is the solution to poverty. The BLEXIT Foundation identifies young leaders in urban communities and helps them create resumes, practice interviews, and learn skills employers desire.

BLEXIT is not a book club or simply talking a big game... No, we're actually making an impact with real individuals committed to serving urban communities. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation encourage entrepreneurship and empower Black and Hispanic communities by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg0r7nltkdb3mrred6hnccpk1cvgjvo1gp7k9kd8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cljmao34cdh2bs)

* **Teaching History:** Critical Race Theory has nothing to do with solving race relations in our country. This is about division and spreading a victimhood message.

The BLEXIT Foundation believes in teaching real American history. It is critical for our urban communities to learn about our Founding Fathers and the Constitution to become productive and educated citizens. [_**Please help the BLEXIT Foundation teach real American history by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zidnt8b80if22240nu935s6idv09lg6ltt99sfe8_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cljmao34cdh2bs)

* **Presenting Our Message:** We have failed to reach urban communities with our message and values. Instead, we've allowed the mainstream media to write the narrative. Not anymore.

The BLEXIT Foundation is going places where no one else goes. We're hosting events in Detroit, Baltimore, and Tampa and starting real conversations. We're not just preaching to the choir, and these aren't boring events. They have music, art, and real conversations, and they are fun! I am committed to reaching urban communities and spreading our message. [_**Please support BLEXIT 's events and help us spread our message by donating here >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zri94rf5jcmn6b7g4bctdvl7f3l8n39oee9r811o_rp22sh2s8i66pb7cljmao34cdh2bs)

The biggest enemy to the media's and BLM's narrative is an intact family. That's why everything we promote comes down to being pro-family, pro-freedom, and pro-faith.

I believe we're going to change society in a fundamental way. Either BLM and the victimhood mentality wins and we all become slaves to the government or we shatter their narrative and bring about a culture of freedom.

Thank you,

Candace Owens
President
BLEXIT Foundation

body:
My name is Andrea Salinas, and I’m running for Congress.
| Hello, my name is Andrea Salinas, and I'm running for Congress in one of the most competitive seats in the entire country. [**In a moment, I 'm going to ask you to split a contribution between my campaign and Voter Protection Project. But if you don't have time to read this email right now, can you please chip in before you click away?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/17634?t=6&akid=3658%2E878179%2EaVRM6U) My dad immigrated to the U.S. from Mexico in 1950. He believed in the power of hard work to make a difference. He worked in the fields, served two tours in Vietnam, and took a union job to provide a path into the middle class for our family.

While we didn't have a lot growing up, my family believed that through hard work, you can achieve anything. It took me seven years to graduate college - and I juggled multiple jobs, from painting houses to pouring coffee - but I put in the hard work and earned that degree.

My daughter was born 17 years ago, and my family's hard work gave me the determination that I needed to leave the world a better place for her. That's why I stepped up to join the Oregon state legislature.

As a legislator, I've fought for more affordable health care, helped Oregon begin to tackle our climate crisis, and passed the nation's most progressive paid family leave bill. It takes hard work to get these things done, but I was determined.

With that same level of determination, I'm running for Congress. I'm ready to fight for families just like mine in Congress, but I need your help. **[That's why I'm asking: Will you please chip in $10 or whatever you can split between my campaign and Voter Protection Project? Voters are sick and tired of big money politicians | | | |

| | | **Dear Peter,**

I’ve knocked on thousands of doors from Garrett County to Gaithersburg.

Voters are repulsed by the news that their member of Congress donated to Governor Abbott. Many people make a face like they just smelled something foul. I explain that the donations to Republicans only stopped just a few months before Trone decided to run for Congress as a Democrat. Voters agree: **Someone who donates to Abbott doesn’t share OUR values.**

Voters are tired of big money politicians. They’re tired of the constant mailers and relentless ads. They know what a big money campaign looks like and they’re excited to learn about my candidacy.

That’s why it’s _so critical_ that we reach as many people as possible. RIGHT NOW. [Please donate here, whatever you can, to help us do that!](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=79a52f2bbd&e=0faa9de128)

Our campaign has reached tens of thousands of voters. **Not through million-dollar ads, but through hard earned donations and lots and lots of personal calls and door knocks. **

And we still have many more people to reach.

If you haven’t donated or volunteered yet, we need you now.
1. Tell 10 or 20 friends. Text or call everyone you know.
2. Knock some doors in your neighborhood! We can get you started today! [Sign up here to volunteer! ](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=634c4108e5&e=0faa9de128)
3. Can you hold a sign and greet voters outside your local voting place on Tuesday, July 19? We want to be represented at EVERY precinct’s polling place.
4. Donate. We need to place a big new order of signs. We need more funds for digital ads. Everything costs money. [Please donate today!](https://bensmilowitz.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0bfd6913686637edfb10b27a3&id=90e2dfbc28&e=0faa9de128)

Thank you for everything you're doing!!
Ben

body:
I have seen plains, fields, oil fires and plenty of voters | | | |

# Listening & Learning
---
|
---
| **Listening and Learning**
---
| I have began traveling across the state to meet with people and hear their concerns. I met a life long ND resident who told me about going all the way to Washington D.C. to meet with Hoeven about sensible gun legislation and Hoeven told them, "the great thing about living in the US is if you don't like the laws in ND, you can move to another state." That is not the answer a real representative gives. A real representative listens and learns and then asks what they can do to help or what can they do to work together.

The more I learn, the more motivated I am to win this race against Hoeven and give people a real voice in Washington D. C.
---
---
|

|

In order for this campaign to operate we need funds to cover basic stuff like ads, signs and banners.

Your donation will fund the campaign against the incumbent John Hoeven. We need to raise $3,800 to pay for 1,000 signs. We need to raise $4000 for 20 banners.

Look at me with this cute puppy on the campaign trail and think happy thoughts and help me unseat the suit that does not represent you.

Fellow Conservative,

My name is Major General Michael "Mick" McGuire, USAF (Ret.) and I’m a husband, a father, and a proud Arizonan.

I’m facing Mark Kelly - Chuck Schumer’s right-hand man - [**and I need your support today in order to win this race and help Republicans WIN BACK the Senate majority!**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=90ff3e2c9935470f869f8a10a99c97de&_e=YL9gnHHg18XzKmPo7siVnleFHdurwBDJVkAMYfE7FDMjJhvBeHIWhFY7QUafRCfOppzfLhmBAL0EF8hUgRwcVPKc3LGGqdAva5pZNDBlC6zSw_6Nd10-zrghvsfVkYio4yMphRzMHOE3ZduZiiTKV03ad5QGeTkRcva7P4R66qrLTOdemdhopYifWptuqOdTDjQ-d62ytbGx1OW2Dxa_KLqdidwGEOJ72MdmST2ZfSvW8MMsMhHDpL4w3DX4ICaDPP4KpTbcwfn5f3_ItUdFwnK4K0z68G6fAqY5N3XWLpdb4yVVlzkwUB2gNeeIjks3w9ErppRxt7vg97rmr7iUXLd9n5Y3RvaAnrjsYNRQeG_mCSOZcPpirtQtrIb0B1gFOk_c7gaAHwjmHflosvSY4g%3D%3D)

[** ****JOIN MY TEAM ➤ **](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=90ff3e2c9935470f869f8a10a99c97de&_e=YL9gnHHg18XzKmPo7siVnleFHdurwBDJVkAMYfE7FDMjJhvBeHIWhFY7QUafRCfOppzfLhmBAL0EF8hUgRwcVPKc3LGGqdAva5pZNDBlC6zSw_6Nd10-zrghvsfVkYio4yMphRzMHOE3ZduZiiTKV03ad5QGeTkRcva7P4R66qrLTOdemdhopYifWptuqOdTI4hphfBQyTUz_rx6jkgu-l59Oy-esJx_gwZ98heIYkJ92oxdZX-3HK7y6zdi1gnh6T8Oumjq6onlFV3O-mp71YROdJhZyu3IXCVPS7FRSrFCiL99hZtFZoy1joiUJhq8aDcudUlXfZRbYd9cLO37byxsCNIDI3PlMWiW4KV6KozHC9UsBpBzWXtnqwppROX7n00LgOHkEGi0f6OivEYMTg%3D%3D)
Washington is broken. There are too many politicians who are only worried about making the right decision for THEMSELVES and NOT the American people they promised to protect.

As a former F-16 pilot and retired commanding general of the Arizona National Guard, I know what it takes to lead a team and make split second decisions that is the difference between saving and losing lives.

I’m ready on day one to fight for YOU and for what’s right for this country. That means:
1. Securing our border
2. Standing for life
3. Protecting our First and Second Amendment rights and
4. Walking shoulder to shoulder with law enforcement.

Hello Friend,

When you hear about North Korea, you think of socialism, dictatorship, food shortages, and poor living conditions.

But little is told about what happens to the citizens. What happened to me.

My name is Grace Jo. I escaped North Korea and the horrors of socialism.

Most Americans today don’t understand what socialism does to you. How it steals your humanity–starves your soul, your mind, your stomach of all that freedom provides.

_That’s why I want to tell my story to students across America_.

**Young Voice’s Dissident Project brings survivors of tyrannical socialist countries to high schools around the United States to tell their stories.**

We are countering the mainstream narratives about how peaceful and successful socialism can be. Too many young people are taught to believe the United States is an evil, oppressive country and that capitalism is a failure.

[_**Friend, can you help sponsor a student for just $15, so they can hear my story—the story of a survivor? Click here to donate $15, $45, $90, or any amount >>>**_](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e560a123e69940c4945f17dd312c8304&_e=8xNpe_eow6wjkylVzT8ewrhqpwXwItD0GaZiAr-T8xhRWPcGkGrosF1A2XKL6Neqf2m7zX86w0nBnygBy9y2p9naPkL5SsdqvzTzZX6T94PWZltJx8z7H4Z7wzP1scG_Yblpi_qRnxfcm-6BJ4geAwGoFQWgfhloX_JBTK0vkxVeGeYq3FtXfo4tPLY2hTJyxsKy6hhZpjXIFI5Llggf_vzspE3ZFggX78ex55GOUKa8dS7Kd-WP_8kJnBdEUuDYSjuwRijZNcPYd14b5qQsBkAmSTWn9lPTXvy1Nq5WbrU2cEUhbuQBnope1zKL_bth)

I am starting to see more and more similarities between North Korea and America.

College students and others now censor themselves to avoid public backlash over the tiniest of things.

This reminds me of how in North Korea, everyone must censor themselves because if they’re caught saying anything negative about the regime, they could be thrown in jail or even executed. While no one is getting executed in the United States, people are self-censoring, or else they get kicked out of prestigious organizations or canceled by online mobs.
[](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e560a123e69940c4945f17dd312c8304&_e=8xNpe_eow6wjkylVzT8ewrhqpwXwItD0GaZiAr-T8xhRWPcGkGrosF1A2XKL6Neqf2m7zX86w0nBnygBy9y2p9naPkL5SsdqvzTzZX6T94PdGXcSyFi2R2b_GfMd3f7U0-wN0aBKb-vxi7Kh5bXX3xcB73M7KtHyti45Ucu0q9o9OO2AqvST3U3hKqMng2n9qRHsD0QWIkJUW7SflOU6-a_cJ_6K8aqFxsMzEA-o1V7P3EM-KF_vFTRQ8z35JE5WBrbHnplYF-ZNL2-uaxtn2RwQc-DAfPZRyD7o1sSwnbTO0ye8KRsbkoSLAQBKQPIH)

**This is my story:**

[](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=e560a123e69940c4945f17dd312c8304&_e=8xNpe_eow6wjkylVzT8ewrhqpwXwItD0GaZiAr-T8xhRWPcGkGrosF1A2XKL6Neqf2m7zX86w0nBnygBy9y2p9naPkL5SsdqvzTzZX6T94Ma6YvAR8WTuE7UQdgRPcnS657H0U-tEkX_-91CBksYecTz6RZ1Qk4w4M0v-GP2npdWXTgBL0YebO4nv6No-wCLhK19hvxjQesV7_kcKjBOSrn9FPoDkqyHCmOZOQW4fvFB0iv2MuSfJFOUyF6G0S2yw1TVWK2UQQcnMLjr7GGihR96R32HXBoePMyMQz-qFjGJHQwhAPrr-yHizg4u3tjc)

During the 90s, North Korea suffered one of the world’s worst famines.

During that time, I only ate about 1 meal a week—a little rice, maybe some vegetables. Sometimes even mice that we caught.

In 1998, my grandmother and younger brothers all passed away because of starvation. The food situation was very bad. My younger brother and I were starved for 10 days straight. We only drank cold water because there was no food we could find.

My father was tortured and starved to death, he passed away when North Korean agents transferred him from a detention center to a jail, and his “crime” was that he left his country in search of food for his family.

That was when my mother, sister, and I first escaped, and it turned into the first of many, as we were caught, repatriated, and escaped again.

Some of my family escaped, but most were murdered by the regime.

This is just a small part of my story, Friend.

Coming to America changed my life.

**In North Korea, we are taught to avoid Americans. If we see them, we should try to kill them because they are our enemies.**

But I’ve learned that that isn’t true. Americans are kind, generous, and caring.

But little is told about what happ Hello Friend, When you hear about North Korea, you think of socialism, dictatorship, food shortages, and poor living conditions. But little is told about what happens to the citizens. What happened to me. My name is Grace Jo. I escaped North Korea and the horrors of socialism. Most Americans today don’t understand what socialism does to you. How it steals your humanity–starves your soul, your mind, your stomach of all that freedom provides. That’s why I want to tell my story to students across America. Young Voice’s Dissident Project brings survivors of tyrannical socialist countries to high schools around the United States to tell their stories. We are countering the mainstream narratives about how peaceful and successful socialism can be. Too many young people are taught to believe the United States is an evil, oppressive country and that capitalism is a failure. I am starting to see more and more similarities between North Korea and America. College students and others now censor themselves to avoid public backlash over the tiniest of things. This reminds me of how in North Korea, everyone must censor themselves because if they’re caught saying anything negative about the regime, they could be thrown in jail or even executed. While no one is getting executed in the United States, people are self-censoring, or else they get kicked out of prestigious organizations or canceled by online mobs. This is my story: During the 90s, North Korea suffered one of the world’s worst famines. During that time, I only ate about 1 meal a week—a little rice, maybe some vegetables. Sometimes even mice that we caught. In 1998, my grandmother and younger brothers all passed away because of starvation. The food situation was very bad. My younger brother and I were starved for 10 days straight. We only drank cold water because there was no food we could find. My father was tortured and starved to death, he passed away when North Korean agents transferred him from a detention center to a jail, and his “crime” was that he left his country in search of food for his family. That was when my mother, sister, and I first escaped, and it turned into the first of many, as we were caught, repatriated, and escaped again. Some of my family escaped, but most were murdered by the regime. This is just a small part of my story, Friend. Coming to America changed my life. In North Korea, we are taught to avoid Americans. If we see them, we should try to kill them because they are our enemies. But I’ve learned that that isn’t true. Americans are kind, generous, and caring. That’s why I’m asking for your support, Friend. Can you help sponsor the Dissident Program, so I can share my story? Click any button to send your donation. Thank you, Grace Jo Sent to Defend the Constitution subscribers. 625 First Street #183, Alexandria, VA 22314

name: Gisele Barreto Fetterman
subject: An update from your SLOP
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
I have a quick update! 💕
#
Hi, Derek, it’s your SLoP Gisele. ❤️
All too often, politics is icky. But João and I know that it can and should be a warmer, kinder place.
Before I ask for your support for the campaign, I just wanted to share a few fun moments from the past week that gave me all the feels. 😍
Yesterday, we stopped by the PA Democrats’ volunteer summit in Pittsburgh. Though John may have gotten a standing ovation when he walked in, he assured the crowd that I’m still everyone’s favorite. (Obviously) 😂
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220711-2?refcode=em20220711-6485&refcode2=6485_434096_gJZNl1&akid=6485%2E434096%2EgJZNl1)
Bonus Pic: Mom and Dad outside the Pittsburgh field office!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220711-2?refcode=em20220711-6485&refcode2=6485_434096_gJZNl1&akid=6485%2E434096%2EgJZNl1)
Earlier in the week, I convinced everyone to come with me to the beautiful Schwirian Farm Sunflower Festival in Monongahela. (Even Grace was thrilled -- can you tell?)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220711-2?refcode=em20220711-6485&refcode2=6485_434096_gJZNl1&akid=6485%2E434096%2EgJZNl1)
We experienced the true beauty of a Western PA summer day among rows and rows of sunflowers! 🌻
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220711-2?refcode=em20220711-6485&refcode2=6485_434096_gJZNl1&akid=6485%2E434096%2EgJZNl1)
Finally, look at this hilarious headline from my favorite Brazilian language newspaper:**“Husband of Brazilian leads senate race in Pennsylvania.” ❤️**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220711-2?refcode=em20220711-6485&refcode2=6485_434096_gJZNl1&akid=6485%2E434096%2EgJZNl1)
So basically, Gisele’s husband or “Giselo” 😂😂 .
I hope you enjoyed this little update from our family to yours, and please know that I am endlessly grateful for your support. Even just reading and opening our emails all helps build momentum and excitement over our campaign at a time when the stakes have never been higher for PA and our country. 💕
[**_I know my husband will fight for your family as hard as he fights for ours. Can you please donate $5 to elect “Gisele’s Husband” to the U.S. Senate? (We don’t take money from icky corporate PACs or shady billionaires, thank you very much)._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220711-2?refcode=em20220711-6485&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6485_434096_gJZNl1&akid=6485%2E434096%2EgJZNl1)
**[Donate now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220711-2?refcode=em20220711-6485&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&refcode2=6485_434096_gJZNl1&akid=6485%2E434096%2EgJZNl1)**
Thank you again, Derek, from the bottom of my heart. We’re in this together and having João’s back is how we’ll win.
With love,
Gisele ❤️
Gisele Barreto Fetterman
Second Lady of Pennsylvania (SLoP)
P.S. Did you see how our campaign trolled Dr. Oz down the Jersey Shore this weekend? Totally normal conversation in our household. João: we’re going to fly a plane in NJ welcoming Dr. Oz home. Me: Okay, but add a ❤️ in there.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220711-2?refcode=em20220711-6485&refcode2=6485_434096_gJZNl1&akid=6485%2E434096%2EgJZNl1)

**[Donate](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-emails?refcode=em20220711-6485-footer&t=1&refcode2=6485_434096_gJZNl1&akid=6485%2E434096%2EgJZNl1)**

name: Thomas Gueli
subject: KSFG Volunteers
body:
Good afternoon volunteers,

First, thank you for your support to make Kelly Schulz Maryland’s next governor. We are 8 days away from the Primary Election on July 19th. We need your help to get Kelly elected and make Maryland safe, steady and prosperous. Our priority is to get out the vote and connect with undecided voters. You can help in multiple ways.

Door Knocking
Volunteers and field staff door knock every day. You can door knock in your region by installing the Advantage app. Our team goes out door knocking every day and we would love for you to join us. It's as simple as downloading the app and following the map. We can show you the process.

Phone Banking
Phone banking is easy and something you can do from the comfort of your home or office. You can make thousands of calls in just a few hours. We are hosting two special phone banking events before the primary: one tomorrow, July 12th from 5 p.m. to 8 p.m., at our campaign headquarters and then another one on election day starting at 9 a.m. This will occur all day on July 19th at the campaign headquarters.

Office Assistance
Volunteers come in the office on an as needed basis to stuff envelopes. Our next session is tomorrow, July 12th at noon.

Poll Watching
We will deploy folks across the state to watch polls on Election Day. Let us know if you can help in your jurisdiction.

If you are interested in assisting Kelly or have any questions, please reply to this email with your contact information so we can follow up accordingly.

[thomas@kellyschulzforgovernor.com](mailto:thomas@kellyschulzforgovernor.com)
[katie@kellyschulzforgovernor.com](mailto:katie@kellyschulzforgovernor.com)

My best,
Thomas

We just submitted 717,000 signatures to the Los Angeles County Registrar to get the recall of soft-on-crime DA George Gascon on the ballot!

**This was 150,000 more than the requirement.**

The registrar now has 30 days to validate our signatures before we officially qualify for the ballot, after which the date of the election will be set.

Not just meeting but blowing the signature requirement out of the water is a **HUGE victory** in and of itself. It signals that **the people of Los Angeles are sick and tired of Gascon's deadly soft-on-crime policies** , which have left citizens and law enforcement officers dead and many more victimized.

But we can't forget that this is not our finish line, **and we can't take our eyes off the prize.**

Friend,
**Our country is currently facing a great threat.** A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize.
This enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the American way of life are clear and intensifying: _stifling dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted version of history._
A group that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but -- perhaps in an even more sinister way -- tear down the American spirit itself. **They go after the family unit, parental rights, traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education.**
Over the past few years, we've watched horrified as this group has attempted to _**brainwash our children**_ into thinking we live in an evil, racist, irredeemable country.
We listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater all the while _**trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the Constitution.**_
[**> > DONATE NOW TO HELP US CONTINUE THE FIGHT <<**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=909c191d4e104b63bcf5f58d7c632610&_e=0gHw_mRWR4WkcIaRn2YKf8ik3KGNw-DTHG_SKzNpPjnbGColyYFOHBFnsuwkAYBp1kw_gQ8UFdGagql4GuIyKGBzru3dC4iv7MbOJoTuFOQndDIbjnHrIAyIuSMZUMUSNyHJIj0H2Vhqe4pgHruafR8wv788-e7EwK0ZV8_Uw_3zI9pw4vpMw-HGIhqJ9QOk-o55J1r-Sw-4swcQ0QYgV0iR_9qA_9FI5yb__2ZCd7ukFZPb2T5MVytI2XkM5sVllGPXGlAJm44Tqe3HzjpZdshnz3UrCipBQ5y4R94o44s5KS6ggULJKnozCZziMMQWDKREmLH-BP10JbcWvE1pS_iaKWoU7FHtSgLQ4XeptDvMc5qrRw1HXtwPERBOnWOlIbfcMCjQNvZI3vDWZ9Y7LA%3D%3D)
We saw them take to the streets for an entire summer like outlaws burning, looting, and destroying everything in sight while being told they were "mostly peaceful" and "passionate."
We watched _**Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of truth**_ - deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through the digital public square.
We listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news stories that didn't align with their preferred narrative, only to watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically expedient time.
**Well,****Friend****, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines is over.**
[**> >> FIGHT BACK <<<**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=909c191d4e104b63bcf5f58d7c632610&_e=0gHw_mRWR4WkcIaRn2YKf8ik3KGNw-DTHG_SKzNpPjnbGColyYFOHBFnsuwkAYBp1kw_gQ8UFdGagql4GuIyKGBzru3dC4iv7MbOJoTuFOQndDIbjnHrIAyIuSMZUMUSNyHJIj0H2Vhqe4pgHruafR8wv788-e7EwK0ZV8_Uw_3zI9pw4vpMw-HGIhqJ9QOk1c-btkz30FckKpvqFRsK6qMSdcSpWun5kb7e6nI1rFUrwXT4U_FGdQ2PgJnuY4kM8RBw4fsJxfxjYd5Xrdl2tU7xDsKxfYi8b1dAxvVPPzphZOeVIt8phNX2J3jAq2xtZPDQyCHDFp27bBNdBz5BB-X7mOG7AIhJ_4PTcf-yKbP2U0RD_UY7o3pVyLnwKQ_22AKMsceVadTRJR51zIahLg%3D%3D)
This enemy has taken over media, educational institutions, corporate boards, professional sports, foundations, and professional institutions. They have left no corner of our lives untouched. But all hope is not lost.
**We The People still have a say.** We know the truth, you and I, about America and the country she is and can be. We must fight to defeat these false pretenses and predetermined narratives.
**I am choosing to counter this enemy with faith, with reason, and with freedom. As Governor of the Free State of Florida, I have chosen to lead with a vision that builds America up rather than tears it down.**

A new enemy has emerged from the shadows that seeks to destroy and intimidate their way to a transformed state, and country, that you and I would hardly recognize. This enemy is the radical vigilante woke mob that will steamroll anything and anyone in their way. Their blatant attacks on the American way of life are clear and intensifying: stifling dissent, public shaming, rampant violence, and a perverted version of history. A group that will, literally, tear down monuments and buildings but -- perhaps in an even more sinister way -- tear down the American spirit itself. They go after the family unit, parental rights, traditional moral values, the church, and fact-based education. Over the past few years, we've watched horrified as this group has attempted to brainwash our children into thinking we live in an evil, racist, irredeemable country. We listened to them deny science and data to exert political theater all the while trampling over personal liberties enshrined in the Constitution. We saw them take to the streets for an entire summer like outlaws burning, looting, and destroying everything in sight while being told they were "mostly peaceful" and "passionate." We watched Big Tech moguls in Silicon Valley be the arbiters of truth - deciding who gets to speak and who gets silenced through the digital public square. We listened to the legacy media muffle legitimately verifiable news stories that didn't align with their preferred narrative, only to watch the truth trickle out months later at a more politically expedient time. Well,Friend, the time for listening and watching from the sidelines is over.
